observations: body L1-L6: «al–Battānī» (L1, L3) is not letter-spaced; its long dashes measure 5.5 and 5.4 pt, and the dash before «Ceterum» 10.2 pt. A thin stroke after «et» (L4), like a comma, and a point between «positis» and «contingens» are specks and are not transcribed. The obliquity of the ecliptic decreases by about 47″ a century: in the 743 years from Ptolemy (137) to al-Battānī (880) by 5′ 49″, the 6′ of L5; Ptolemy's 23° 51′ 20″ exceeds al-Battānī's 23° 35′ by 16′ 20″, about the quarter of a degree of L5.
body L7: the dash after «c)» measures 10.2 pt; the dash of «3–4» is joined to both figures and is long (5.8 pt).

body L8-L21: «Albatenii» and «aṣ–Ṣūfī» are letter-spaced. «odh–dhu’ābah» (L8) is printed with an o for the a of «adh», and «le Chevelure» (L11) for «la Chevelure»; both are kept. «al-fard» (L8) has a hyphen (3.4 pt); the other dashes of the names are long (4.4 to 5.5 pt). The Arabic words are «الشجاع» (ash-shujā‘, the Hydra, L12), «منفرد» (munfarid, isolated, L14) and «مرزمي الشعريين» (mirzamā ’sh-shi‘rayayn, the two mirzam of the two Shi‘rà, L17). In the translation, p. 125, l. 3-4, the stars of the Almagest are 1022 «praeter adh–dhu’ābah, al–fard et al–mirzam».
body L22-L23: the dash after «d)» measures 10.1 pt, that of «10–22» 5.4 pt; the head has no full stop, as printed.

body L24-L34: «al–Battānī» (L24, L25) and «aṣ–Ṣūfī» are letter-spaced; «37–38» has a long dash (5.0 pt). «libre» (L29) is printed for «livre» and is kept. The Arabic of L26 is «مذهب العرب» (madhhab al-‘arab, the method of the Arabs). A speck over the e of «le» (L32) is not transcribed. The translation, p. 125, l. 10-12, has «ash–sharaṭāni ... in cornubus et al–buṭayn in cauda» and «Pleiades in cornu, et ad–dabarān in dorso».
notes_left L1: the dash of «5–6» is joined to the 5 and is long (5.0 pt).
notes_left L7-L9: «al-Battānī», divided between L7 and L8, is letter-spaced, with a hyphen at the end of L7 (3.1 pt) and another at the beginning of L8 (3.5 pt); «adh-dhu’ābah» has a hyphen (3.1 pt).
notes_right L3-L8: «Al-Battānī», «ad-dabarān» and «ath-thurayyā» have hyphens (2.8, 3.5 and 3.2 pt); the first y of «thurayyā» prints broken. «p 156» is printed without a full stop.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
